# Jobs (11 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /linkedin/search | `query` / `cursor` | 10 | Search LinkedIn job listings |
| /linkedin | `id` | 5 | Get a LinkedIn job listing by id |
| /linkedin/organizations | `query` | 1 | Resolve LinkedIn organization ids |
| /indeed/search | `query` / `cursor`, `country_code` / `cursor` | 10 | Search Indeed job listings |
| /indeed | `id` | 5 | Get an Indeed job listing by id |
| /bing/search | `query` / `cursor`, `location` / `cursor` | 10 | Search Bing job listings |
| /bing | `id` | 5 | Get a Bing job listing by id |
| /xing/search | `query` / `cursor` | 10 | Search Xing job listings |
| /xing | `id` | 5 | Get a Xing job listing by id |
| /salary/titles | `query`, `country_code` | 1 | Suggest job titles for a salary lookup |
| /salary | `query`, `country_code` | 1 | Get salary ranges for a job title and country |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /linkedin/search — 10cr

Returns LinkedIn job listings matching a keyword and optional location, date, employment type, experience, workplace, or company-id filters. Each row has job id, title, company, location, posting date, and listing URL. Pass an id to GET /v1/jobs/linkedin for the full description. Page 2 with the cursor from page 1.

**Parameters**

- `location` *(optional)*: City or country. Defaults to worldwide when omitted.
- `organization_ids` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated LinkedIn organization ids from GET /v1/jobs/linkedin/organizations.
- `date_posted` *(optional)*: Maximum age: month, week, or day.
- `employment_types` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: contractor, fulltime, parttime, intern, temporary.
- `experience_levels` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: intern, entry, associate, midSenior, director.
- `workplace_types` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: remote, hybrid, onSite.
- `query` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `query`: Keywords, job title, or company name. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/linkedin/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /linkedin — 5cr

Returns one LinkedIn job: title, company, location, employment type, seniority, applicant count, description, and listing URL. Use an id from GET /v1/jobs/linkedin/search.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Numeric LinkedIn job id from linkedin/search.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/linkedin?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /linkedin/organizations — 1cr

Returns LinkedIn companies and schools matching a name, each with a display name and numeric id. Pass those ids as organization_ids on GET /v1/jobs/linkedin/search to filter listings by employer.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Company or school name.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/linkedin/organizations?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /indeed/search — 10cr

Returns Indeed job listings matching a keyword, country, and optional city, sort, and radius. Each row includes title, company, location, description, and apply URL. country_code is required on page 1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Page 2 with the cursor from page 1.

**Parameters**

- `location` *(optional)*: City or region within the country.
- `sort_type` *(optional)*: relevance (default) or date.
- `radius` *(optional)*: Distance from location.
- `radius_type` *(optional)*: km (default) or miles.
- `query` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `query`: Keywords, job title, or company name. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
- `country_code` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `country_code`: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example us, de, kr). (one of: country_code, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/indeed/search?query=<query>&country_code=<country_code>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /indeed — 5cr

Returns one Indeed job: title, company, location, description, and apply URL. Use an id from GET /v1/jobs/indeed/search.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Indeed job id from indeed/search.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/indeed?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /bing/search — 10cr

Returns aggregated job listings from Bing matching a keyword and location, with optional date, employment type, and remote-only filters. Each row has title, company, location, and the original job board. List rows do not include an apply URL; pass an id to GET /v1/jobs/bing for the description and apply link. location is required on page 1.

**Parameters**

- `date_posted` *(optional)*: Maximum age: week or day.
- `employment_types` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: contractor, fulltime, parttime, temporary.
- `remote_only` *(optional)*: When true, only remote listings.
- `query` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `query`: Keywords, job title, or company name. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
- `location` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `location`: City or country. Required on page 1. (one of: location, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/bing/search?query=<query>&location=<location>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /bing — 5cr

Returns one Bing-aggregated job: title, company, location, employment type, description, and apply URL. Use an id from GET /v1/jobs/bing/search.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Bing job id from bing/search.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/bing?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /xing/search — 10cr

Returns Xing job listings matching a keyword, with optional German-language location, date, employment type, career level, remote option, and minimum yearly salary filters. Rows often include a salary range. Page 2 with the cursor from page 1.

**Parameters**

- `location` *(optional)*: City or country, preferably in German (for example Berlin, Schweiz).
- `date_posted` *(optional)*: Maximum age: month, week, or day.
- `employment_types` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: contractor, fulltime, intern, parttime, seasonal, temporary, voluntary.
- `career_levels` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: student, entry, professional, manager, executive, seniorExecutive.
- `remote_options` *(optional)*: Semicolon-separated: remote, hybrid, onSite.
- `minimum_salary` *(optional)*: Minimum yearly salary. Listings whose range intersects this floor are returned.
- `query` / `cursor` — at least one required.
  - `query`: Keywords, job title, or company name. Required on page 1. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)
  - `cursor`: Opaque cursor from the previous page. (one of: query, cursor; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/xing/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /xing — 5cr

Returns one Xing job: title, company, location, employment type, remote option, salary range, description, and apply URL. Use an id from GET /v1/jobs/xing/search.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Xing job id from xing/search.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/xing?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /salary/titles — 1cr

Returns known job titles matching a query in a country, each with a listing count. Use a returned title as query on GET /v1/jobs/salary.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Partial job title (for example programming, nurse).
- `country_code`: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/salary/titles?query=<query>&country_code=<country_code>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /salary — 1cr

Returns min, max, mean, and median pay for a job title in a country, broken out hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly, plus the local currency. Use GET /v1/jobs/salary/titles first when the title is uncertain.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Job title, preferably one returned by salary/titles.
- `country_code`: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/jobs/salary?query=<query>&country_code=<country_code>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
